title: Orthonormality of Hermite functions
statement: For every dimension $n$, the multivariate normalized Hermite functions form an orthonormal family in $L^2( br^n, gamma_n)$, where $ gamma_n$ is the product of $n$ standard Gaussian probability measures.
hypotheses_covered: Dimension $n$ is a natural number, with no further restriction.
